import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0082 {α : Type _} (l : List α) (n : Nat) : 
  List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < n) l) ≤ List.length l := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0082 {α : Type _} (l : List α) (n : Nat) : 
  List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < n) l) ≤ List.length l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h1 : x < n ∨ x ≥ n := by exactI Or.inr (Nat.le_refl x)
    split
    · exactI ih
    · exactI Nat.le_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_of_le_of_not_le (Nat.le_refl x) h1) (Nat.le_refl x)
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0082 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0082 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0082

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0082
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0082
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
